label_arithmetic: native long double; raw paths and float64 arrival sidecars plus integer knots retained

role_partition.source: E1 p0_plan.role_codes; unchanged unordered-pair seeded permutation

sampler.SDC: one closest-to-center node per occupied128 subcell; ordinary uniform without replacement over its eligible role pool; target candidates from remaining shuffled pool sorted stably by source64_score+destination64_score
sampler.RandomFT: uniform without replacement over all eligible directed node OD pairs in role0; no forced ordinary/targeted mixture and no qualification filter
sampler.targeted_eligibility: any affected departure in the complete two-departure group
sampler.common_development_and_test: single shared SDC/reference80/20 source mixture for Aselect,Acal,mixed_test; never strategy-specific tests

detector.canonical_pair_rule: lower-node-id directed representative in reciprocal topology, identical to legacy detector
detector.cell_score: sum significant-pair relative_change at its endpoint64 cells; once when both endpoints share a cell
detector.ranking: score descending; grid ID ascending ties

affected.changed_edge_at_entry: at least one G1-route arc in a detector-significant canonical pair has different G0/G1 continuous travel time at the same G1 entry time
affected.internal_hotspot: a non-first/non-last path node visits a selected hotspot64 cell; an endpoint cell counts if also visited internally
affected.same_clock_path_changed: G1 node path differs from the stable same-departure G0 reference path
affected.main_test: all complete mixed_test groups whose group predicate is true; retain both departures
additional_diagnostics: true affected-point count and affected-points-only metrics
fully frozen NoFT weights and original G0 threshold
affected.duration_change: diagnostic only; not an additional eligibility clause

training.loss: identical accepted E1 two-channel CFM with occupancy weights and actual4096-cell normalization
training.shuffle: each full point row exactly once per epoch
training.selection: all common Aselect points after each epoch1..5; min(microRecall,microF1), same compactness/precision/earlier-epoch ties as E1
training.calibration: all common Acal points after checkpoint selection; same exact threshold criterion as E1

evaluation.mask: threshold then common road_support and endpoint insertion
evaluation.NoFT_main: weights frozen; recalibrate on the same complete Acal role
evaluation.NoFT_diagnostic: same cached base scores with the original G0 threshold; zero G1 calibration labels for this diagnostic
evaluation.metrics: point micro TP/FP/FN; no across-seed standard deviation

freeze_order: freeze this contract and source/role capacity before GT qualification
qualify targets and freeze all shared final development/test identities without model predictions
independently accept all G0/G1 routes, native64 labels and evidence before FT
train four full FT runs and calibrate three strategies per city
full raw-prediction recount, six E2 rows and LaTeX compilation
scope_limit: historical full-day post-update snapshot adaptation; no strictly causal real-time-service claim
sampler_rng_rule: numpy PCG64 Generator seeded by SeedSequence([sampler_seed, city_code, role_code]); XA city_code0, BJ1; Random Afit uses role_code99
